conventions.changes: cN is the Studio change record for candidates/<name> (recorded ready, in order c1..c6, in a fresh state dir, its new_* files byte-equal to the candidate files); its D report with change_impact's default mode must carry input.candidate equal to the frozen one
conventions.map: M and N are scored on GET /api/appmap (the whole lattice.appmap/1 map, or the section response {schema, state, inputs, <section>}) of the named corpus; field names are the prereg D1 ones (rules[].impl_status, basis, evidence, workflows; workflows[] = report flow rows + steps; machines[]; access.cells[] {row, col, spec, route, auth, refusals, route_status, observed[{flow, step, status}]}; endpoints[]).
conventions.observed_join: a request step of a report-verified flow joins cell (row, col) when (caller or 'no token') == row and its route template with every {name} segment written {} equals col (the form the Spike C report and ReviewData use)

spec_rules.R73: A check-in `date` after the user's today answers 422 with code `date_in_future`.
spec_rules.R74: A check-in `date` before the habit's `start_date` or after its `end_date` answers 422 with code `date_out_of_range`.
spec_rules.R75: A check-in `date` more than 60 days before the user's today (earlier than `t - 60`) answers 422 with code `date_too_old`; `t - 60` itself is accepted.
spec_rules.R77: `note` is at most 280 characters; longer answers 422 `validation_failed` with field `note`.
